hero_title: Make something alive. Take it home.
hero_lede: Small evening classes in kombucha, hot sauce and kimchi. You chop, salt, pitch and taste, then leave with a jar that keeps changing on your shelf all week.
fact1_label: people at most in every class
fact2_label: you made yourself, to take home
fact3_label: the year our oldest culture started
classes_lede: Each class runs about two and a half hours around one long table. Aprons, jars and snacks included.
class1_body: Brew a first batch, learn to read a SCOBY, and bottle a flavored second ferment. You take home a starter and your own jar.
class2_body: Mash peppers, salt them to the gram, and plan a sauce from mild to rude. Your mash comes home to ferment for two weeks.
class3_body: Salt napa cabbage, build a paste from scratch and pack it tight. You leave with a full litre and a feeding schedule.
bar_title: The tasting bar opens on Fridays
bar_body: Six kombuchas on tap, a flight of this month's hot sauces, and kimchi toasties from the back kitchen. Bring the jar you made and we will tell you how it is doing.
box_body: One starter culture, a recipe card and a spice mix arrive at your door each month. Keep it alive, feed it, and share it with a neighbor.
foot_address: Rua Pascoal de Melo 42, Arroios, 1000 Lisboa
foot_hours: Classes Tue to Thu 19:00, bar Fri 18:00
step1_b: We open with five ferments at different ages so you know what you are aiming for.
step2_b: Salt ratios decide everything. You learn to weigh and why two percent is the magic number.
step3_b: You pack, weight and seal your own jar, and label it with the date and your name.
step4_b: We send a short guide for the first week so you know which bubbles are good bubbles.
hero_alt: Jars of fermenting vegetables on a green shelf
quote: I came for the hot sauce and left with a jar, a new hobby and three neighbors I now trade ferments with.
